name: Leviathan's Catch
tooltip: Tidehunter's permanent stacks from Leviathan's Catch.
description:
Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain 5 Health, 2 Attack Range, and 1 Bonus Damage Block.
Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.

name: Supernatural
tooltip: Muerta's Supernatural stacks, gained and lost over the game.
description: Whenever an enemy hero dies within 925 units of Muerta, she gains a stack of 1% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.

name: Culling Blade
tooltip: Axe's permanent stacks from Culling Blade kills.
description: Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.

name: Armor Power
tooltip: Clockwerk's permanent armor from consumed Chainmails.
description:
Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +4 armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
Clockwerk's outgoing damage also increases by 0.55845% per point of armor.

name: Essence Shift
tooltip: Slark's permanent Agility stolen by killing heroes affected by Essence Shift.
description:
Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining 1 of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus 3 Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals 1 Agility.
Only the permanent stacks from kills count here, not the temporary ones from attacks.

name: Finger of Death
tooltip: Lion's permanent Finger of Death bonus damage from hero kills.
description:
Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills.
One stack per hero killed; several kills in the same moment (a Scepter Finger hitting more than one hero) count as one gain.

name: Suffer In Silence
tooltip: Silencer's permanent Intelligence stolen from enemy heroes dying near him.
description:
If an enemy Hero dies within 925 range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals 1 Intelligence from them. If the victim was silenced, steal an extra 1 Intelligence.
Silencer also takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.

name: Flesh Heap
tooltip: Pudge's permanent Strength stacks from enemy hero kills.
description:
Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining 2 bonus Strength for each stack.
The stacks are kept when Pudge dies.

name: Curiosity
tooltip: Rubick's permanent Curiosity from enemy hero kills.
description:
If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last 3 seconds, he gains 1 Curiosity permanently. Each stack grants 1 base damage, 0.3% Buff/Debuff Duration, and 2 AOE Bonus.
Only these permanent kill stacks count here, not the stacks per level or the temporary ones from seeing enemies cast.

name: Runic Infusion
tooltip: Arc Warden's permanent attributes from activating Power Runes.
description:
Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +1.5 all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
The stacks are kept when Arc Warden dies.

name: Duel
tooltip: Legion Commander's permanent bonus damage from winning Duels.
description:
Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
The count is the bonus damage itself, so each won Duel adds several points at once; it still counts as one gain. Losing a Duel or dying doesn't remove any.

name: Feast
tooltip: Lifestealer's permanent max HP from killing creeps and heroes.
description:
Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains 1 permanent max HP whenever he kills a creep and 10 permanent max HP whenever he kills a hero.
The count is the max HP gained, and it rises on every creep last hit as well as every hero kill, so a Stack gained rule plays very often.
